8. FAQ

1. Q: What information shall I provide you when I need your offer?

A: Normally, please send me your flow, total head, medium, medium temperature, pump material, voltage, frequency, etc so that we can quote you exactly what you need.

2. Q: Do you sell other brands water pumps? And do you accept OEM?

No, we only sell JIADI pump, but you can send me your detailed specification requirement. For instance, we can imprint your logo or brand for you. And we accept OEM.

3. Q: What are the typical submersible pump materials of construction?

A: Cast-iron basic construction represents good value and is useful in most applications; Thermoplastic construction provides excellent value and corrosion resistance; Stainless steel construction has superior corrosion resistance.

4. Q: Can I put a submersible pump into a lake to pump water out of it for my cabin or irrigation?

A: NO, a submersible pump should never be put into water where people or pets will swim. If a splice of the pump was to become exposed, or the electrical integrity of the motor was to fail, the water around the pump could be dangerously "charged" with electricity, which would be possible for someone to get injured or killed.
